name: Should I repair or replace my old windows with energy-efficient ones?

mainEntity.name: Should I repair or replace my old windows with energy-efficient ones?

acceptedAnswer.text: The decision to repair or replace depends on the extent of damage and the age of your current windows. Minor issues like a broken pane or faulty hardware can often be repaired. However, if your windows are old, single-paned, difficult to operate, show signs of rot, or allow significant drafts, replacement with energy-efficient windows is generally a more cost-effective long-term solution. Replacements offer better insulation, lower energy bills, increased comfort, and improved home value, which repairs rarely achieve.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair minor issues; replace if windows are old, single-paned, damaged, or drafty, as new energy-efficient windows offer better insulation, savings, and value.
